candidate_ref_note: To be resolved in Reverification.6 from the final contract commit
verification_rule: Build Legacy V1-V4 Final Schema, build Candidate V1 Final Schema, compare across all 22 schema categories, match exactly one approved delta (DG-001) from the difference set, require DG-001 definition to match approved contract exactly, fail on any other semantic difference.
reference_data_rule: Reference Data must be actually scanned and verified. DG-001 does not change Reference Data. NOT_APPLICABLE may be recorded only when no DML exists, not as an unchecked default.
allowed_differences_exhaustive: The above list is the complete and exhaustive set of allowed differences. No other differences are permitted.
dg_001_mismatch_conditions: Type is not TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
Type is TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE
Type is DATE or other type
Column moved to different schema or table

verification_output_fields.raw_semantic_differences: Count of all semantic differences found
verification_output_fields.approved_differences: Count of differences matching approved deltas exactly
verification_output_fields.unapproved_differences: Count of differences NOT matching any approved delta
verification_output_fields.unexplained_differences: Count of differences with no governance explanation
verification_output_fields.target_schema_equivalence: PASS (expected: all differences accounted for by approved deltas)

deprecated_output_pattern: The old pattern of reporting 'semantic differences: 1' alongside 'schema equivalence: PASS' without explaining the approved delta handling is deprecated. Reports must distinguish strict vs approved-target equivalence. Reports must separately report raw/approved/unapproved/unexplained counts.
